verdicts.reason: A keeps the correct headline→subline→CTA order, but it just spreads the landscape stack down the square. The headline stays at its original size, and there are big, loose gaps (about 110–120px) between the headline, subline and button. The three pieces float apart instead of reading as one group, and it hasn't been rearranged for the square. B scales the headline up well to fill the square, but it moves the CTA button to the very top, above the headline, which breaks the reading order. The subline also ends up jammed near the bottom edge, almost as wide as the canvas, so the layout feels top- and bottom-heavy.
